ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels (interior lobes) and 25% low-intensity black pixels (margins and central peduncle column).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions occupying the central and distal portions of both lobes; thick black perimeter banding (5-15 pixels) along the trailing edge; a central vertical black wedge ascending from the notch; isolated linear black streaks in the upper-left and upper-right quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 65-75 degrees and a vertical depth of approximately 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration across the entire trailing edge; amplitude peaks of 10-20 pixels; right lobe shows more pronounced jagged 'stair-step' topography compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges tapering to pointed distal tips; trailing edges exhibit a multi-stage concave curve trending toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-relief, high-intensity white/grey circular protrusions localized at the distal tips of both lobes, indicating heavy barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear streaks; a prominent diagonal rake mark on the right lobe (approx. 45-degree angle); several shorter vertical/horizontal streaks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (parallel linear disruptions) on both lobes and significant physical trauma/scarring at the fluke tips resulting in irregular perimeter geometry.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique central pigmentation pattern consisting of a narrow, dark vertical spire branching slightly at its apex near the notch.
